name: UmojaFlowOS Portable PostgreSQL Platform
description: Portable UmojaFlowOS deployment contract for self-hosted or cloud-neutral infrastructure.

runtime.object_storage: MinIO or another S3-compatible object store with Object Lock
runtime.search_and_audit: OpenSearch with mTLS and immutable retention controls
runtime.edge_proxy: Caddy or another standards-compliant reverse proxy

configuration.secrets_policy: All credentials are injected by the operator's secret manager or protected file mounts; no default credentials are permitted.
